lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal rows of high-luminance circular nodes distributed across the mid and posterior lateral flank, showing relatively uniform spacing within longitudinal lines.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the primary horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like alignment in the mid-body region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow on the ventral side.
